text: dsh-ofm-codearts-pin 是一个 DSH 插件，用于恢复 dsh-our-free-model 中的华为云 CodeArts 模型渠道。它在启动时挂载修复逻辑，将目标版本固定到 2.5.8，并提供状态查询、立即修复、撤销修复和关闭更新提示的命令。插件通过 DSH 命令服务和只读状态路由提供操作入口，适合需要继续使用该模型渠道的用户。需要先安装 dsh-our-free-model；插件不要求额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin restores the Huawei Cloud CodeArts channel by pinning dsh-our-free-model to 2.5.8 at startup. Use /ofm-pin to check status, apply or undo repairs, or quiet updates; a read-only route shows status. Install dsh-our-free-model first. No API key or external account is needed.
想让 DSH 继续使用华为云 CodeArts 模型渠道。
模型插件升级后 CodeArts 渠道消失了，怎么恢复？
How can I keep the Huawei Cloud CodeArts channel available in DSH?
dsh-ofm-codearts-pin 的功能「启动时固定版本」：插件启动时检查 dsh-our-free-model，并按随包 payload 修复到 2.5.8；配置可关闭自动修复。
dsh-ofm-codearts-pin 的功能「命令查看与管理修复」：通过 /ofm-pin 查询状态，也可执行 apply、restore 或 quiet 操作，查看渠道状态并管理版本修复。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · dsh-ofm-codearts-pin：Pins `dsh-our-free-model` (OFM) to **2.5.8** — the last release that still ships
Huawei Cloud's **CodeArts** channel, and the one where that channel was fixed —
and heals the install back to it on **every boot**.

> 中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Why this exists：OFM 2.5.9 deleted the Huawei Cloud channel outright. The channel pack stops
registering `["CODEARTS", "codearts"]`, the settings page loses the card, and the
account entry (`codearts-…` in `~/.dsh/channel-pack/state.json`) plus its
credential are left behind, unusable and unreachable. Nothing in 2.5.9 can be
configured back into existence.

Version history matters here:

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Why this exists：| Release | CodeArts channel | Works? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2.5.6 | present | **No** — its request signature is rewritten by any plugin that patches global `fetch` (billion-context, cost-meter), so upstream rejects it |
| 2.5.7 | present | Yes — PR #481 moved CodeArts onto an independent signed transport and added the 4004 retry |
| **2.5.8** | **present** | **Yes** — and it is the newest build that still has the channel |
| 2.5.9 | deleted | — |
dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Why this exists：So 2.5.8 is the correct landing point: newest, and working.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · What it does：| Step | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Byte check | On each boot, all 80 installed files are compared to the shipped payload by SHA-256 |
| Exact repair | Only files whose hash actually differs are rewritten; each is backed up, replaced atomically, read back and re-hashed |
| Syntax gate | Every `.js` it writes is `node --check`-ed; a file that fails is restored from backup immediately |
| All-or-nothing | If any step in a pass fails, every file that pass already wrote is rolled back — a half-applied pin never reaches the next boot |
| Payload gate | The archive is unpacked and every extracted file re-hashed first; a payload that fails verification aborts the pin without writing a byte |
| Update check | Sets `updateCheckHours = 0` in `~/.dsh/our-free-model/settings.json` (OFM's own documented opt-out, one key only) |
| Honest report | `index.js`, `client.js` and `package.json` were already read by the time this plugin runs, so the report says `restart required` rather than claiming the whole change is live |

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · What it does：The payload is not a rebuild. It is the exact file set that 2.5.8's own
**Ed25519-signed** `feed/manifest.json` pins, copied byte-for-byte — which is what
makes "restore" reproducible instead of a snapshot of whatever happened to be
installed.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · What it does：It ships as `vendor/payload/2.5.8.tar.gz` (the same form upstream publishes),
unpacked on first use to `~/.dsh/ofm-codearts-pin/payload-2.5.8/` and verified
file by file before anything is written. The archive form exists because
upstream's `pack.js` embeds a Google OAuth client secret: loose files make the
repository unpushable (GitHub push protection rejects the commit), and rewriting
that byte would change the hash the pin is built on. The archive is the only
shape that is both byte-exact and pushable.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop install <this directory>
```

Or from the tarball / git (all three `dsh.install` entries are filled in).

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Install：⚠️ **Order matters.** In `dsh.profile.bundles`, this plugin must appear **before**
`dsh-our-free-model`. That way OFM has not yet imported
`vendor/channel-pack/pack.js` when the pin lands, so the healed pack is the one
that loads and CodeArts is back on that same start. The row in
`cordis.patch.yml` is an id-addressed insert: it adds itself, it does not move
OFM.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Commands：```
/ofm-pin            # status: install dir, files matching, both halves of the channel, profile tarball
/ofm-pin apply      # restore from the payload now
/ofm-pin restore    # undo: put the backups back (removes the pin)
/ofm-pin quiet      # only disable the in-app update check

Read-only status is also served over HTTP:
`GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-ofm-codearts-pin` (loopback only).

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Config：```yaml
config:
  autoPin: true        # false = report drift only, never write
  target: ''           # explicit dsh-our-free-model directory
  quietUpdates: true   # disable the in-app update check

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · The one thing it cannot do for you：The profile's **tarball specifier**. If `dependencies["dsh-our-free-model"]` still
points at an older package, the next `pnpm install` reinstalls that build
underneath the pin. The status output shows the specifier currently in use and
warns about it, but it does not edit profile dependencies — that is the package
manager's territory. Point it at the 2.5.8 tarball.
section: The one thing it cannot do for you

text:
dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Tests：Two suites, both against throwaway fixtures in a temp directory — no network, no
touching a real install:

```sh
npm test           # 11 cases: archive reader and pinner behaviour
npm run test:boot  # 1 simulation: real apply() against a fake cordis context
```

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Tests：Covered: the archive extracts exactly the 80 files the manifest pins; a corrupt
archive is refused; a clean install is left untouched; a 2.5.9-shaped install is
healed (both channel halves return); a single drifted file is the only one
written; a poisoned payload entry is refused; a mid-pass failure rolls everything
back; backups and undo; stale staging files are swept; `quietUpdates` touches one
key; a foreign `.bak` is never mistaken for ours. `test:boot` additionally proves
`apply()` cannot throw, that the command and read-only route each register once,
and that a re-apply is idempotent.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · Licence：MIT. `vendor/payload/2.5.8.tar.gz` is an unmodified copy of the
`dsh-our-free-model` 2.5.8 release payload, redistributed under that project's
MIT licence (see the last section of `LICENSE`). This plugin does not alter
upstream behaviour, branding or endpoints — it only restores files that belong to
that release.

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · dsh-ofm-codearts-pin：把 `dsh-our-free-model`（OFM）钉在 **2.5.8** —— 最后一个还带**华为云 CodeArts** 渠道、
并且已经修好该渠道的版本 —— 然后在**每次启动**时自愈回滚。

> English: [README.md](README.md)

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 为什么需要它：OFM 2.5.9 把华为云渠道整个删了：渠道包里不再注册 `["CODEARTS", "codearts"]`，
设置页也没有卡片，而你的账号 `codearts-…`（在 `~/.dsh/channel-pack/state.json` 里）
和凭据都还在，白白闲置。2.5.9 里没有任何配置能把这条渠道变回来。

版本之间差别很关键：

| 版本 | 华为云渠道 | 能用吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2.5.6 | 在 | **不能** —— 请求签名会被任何改写全局 `fetch` 的插件（billion-context、cost-meter）破坏，上游直接拒 |
| 2.5.7 | 在 | 能 —— PR #481 把 CodeArts 改成独立签名传输，并加了 4004 重试 |
| **2.5.8** | **在** | **能**，而且是最后一个还带这条渠道的版本 |
| 2.5.9 | 已删 | — |

所以 2.5.8 才是正确落点：最新，且可用。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 它做什么：| 动作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 逐文件校验 | 每启动一次，把安装目录 80 个文件和 payload 的 SHA-256 逐个比对 |
| 精确回滚 | 只重写**确实不一致**的文件；每个文件先备份、再原子替换、再读回校验哈希 |
| 语法门禁 | 写完后对 `.js` 跑 `node --check`，语法不过立刻从备份还原 |
| 失败回滚 | 一次执行里如果中途失败，已经写过的文件全部还原，绝不留下半套 |
| payload 校验 | 解包后先逐文件验 hash，验不过就整轮放弃、一个字节都不写 |
| 关掉自动更新 | 把 `~/.dsh/our-free-model/settings.json` 的 `updateCheckHours` 设为 `0`（OFM 的官方关闭方式，只动这一个键） |
| 报告口径诚实 | `index.js` / `client.js` / `package.json` 在插件运行前就已经被读过，所以这几项**必须再重启一次**才生效；报告里直接写 `restart required` |

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 它做什么：payload 不是"重新打包"，而是该版本自己的 **Ed25519 签名 manifest** 所钉住的那套字节。
它以 `vendor/payload/2.5.8.tar.gz` 形式随仓库分发（和上游发 release 的形态一致），
首次使用时解包到 `~/.dsh/ofm-codearts-pin/payload-2.5.8/`，并逐文件核对 SHA-256
之后才拿来用。

> 为什么是压缩包：上游 `pack.js` 里嵌着 Google OAuth 的 client secret，
> 明文散装会让仓库无法推送（GitHub push protection 会拦）；而这个字节又不能改，
> 改了就和新版 hash 对不上、钉版失效。压缩包是唯一同时满足"原样"和"能推送"的形态。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop install <这个目录>
```

或者从 tarball / git 安装（`package.json` 的 `dsh.install` 三段都填好了）。

⚠️ **顺序很重要**：`dsh.profile.bundles` 里本插件必须排在 `dsh-our-free-model`
**前面**。这样启动时 OFM 还没 import `vendor/channel-pack/pack.js`，钉子落地后
加载的就是恢复好的那一份，本次启动华为云就回来了。`cordis.patch.yml` 里的插入行
是 id 寻址的，只加自己，不会挪动 OFM。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 命令：```
/ofm-pin            # 状态：装在哪个目录、几个文件对上、华为云两半在不在、profile 指向哪个 tarball
/ofm-pin apply      # 立刻按 payload 回滚
/ofm-pin restore    # 撤销：把备份放回去（等于解除钉子）
/ofm-pin quiet      # 只关自动更新检查

只读状态也走 HTTP：`GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-ofm-codearts-pin`（仅回环）。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 配置：```yaml
config:
  autoPin: true        # false = 只报告漂移，绝不写盘
  target: ''           # 显式指定 dsh-our-free-model 目录
  quietUpdates: true   # 关掉自动更新检查

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 还剩一件它管不了的事：profile 里的 **tarball specifier**。如果 `package.json` 的
`dependencies["dsh-our-free-model"]` 还指着旧包，下次 `pnpm install` 会在钉子下面
重新装回那个构建。本插件会在状态里显示当前 specifier 并提示，但不会替你改 profile
依赖（那属于包管理器领地）。把它指向 2.5.8 的 tarball 即可。
section: 还剩一件它管不了的事

text:
dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 测试：两个套件，都在临时目录里的假安装上跑，不联网、不碰真实安装：

```sh
npm test           # 11 个用例
npm run test:boot  # 1 个模拟：真实 apply() 走一遍假 cordis 上下文
```

覆盖：压缩包解出的 80 个文件逐个对上 manifest、坏包拒用、干净安装不动、
2.5.9 形状能被还原（渠道两半都回来）、单文件漂移只写那一个、坏 payload 拒写、
中途失败整体回滚、备份与撤销、残留临时文件清理、`quietUpdates` 只动一个键、
外来 `.bak` 不被误认；`test:boot` 另外证明 `apply()` 不抛错、命令与只读路由各
注册一次、重复 apply 幂等。

dsh-ofm-codearts-pin README · 许可：MIT。`vendor/payload/2.5.8.tar.gz` 是 `dsh-our-free-model` 2.5.8 的原样副本，
按该项目 MIT 许可再分发（见 `LICENSE` 末节）。本插件不改上游行为、品牌或端点。
